# Planted slop control

This file exists so the slop gate can prove it still detects slop
before a clean sweep of `docs/` and `book/src` is reportable. It is
scored by `tests/test_gates_fail_closed.py`; the CI step runs the
scorer on it and requires a nonzero exit. Do not clean it up.
